title: Absolute continuity of Bernoulli convolutions (Erdős)
check: Confirmed as a reported disproof: arXiv:2610.12072 (v1 8 Oct, v2 9 Oct 2026) gives dim ν_{1/β} < 1 for every quartic Salem number β. Only two quartic Salem numbers lie in (1, 2), about 1.7221 and 1.8832 (checked by hand: β + 1/β must be (1+√13)/2 or 1+√2); for β > 2 the measure lives on a Cantor set and the drop is trivial. For the two that matter the drop comes from an exact interval computation in Python, with margins of about 1.4e-23 and 7.8e-22. Unrefereed, six days old. arXiv:2610.09902 (cited in the row) was not read.
fix: Add to the retirement line that the two non-trivial cases rest on exact computation with margins near 1e-22, so an independent recomputation should come before the conjecture is treated as dead.

title: The localization transition of random band matrices
check: Confirmed: settled in one dimension up to N^{±c}. Yau-Yin (arXiv:2501.01718, v1 3 Jan 2025): W ≥ N^{1/2+c}, all bulk eigenvectors delocalised, quantum unique ergodicity, GUE local statistics. Erdős-Riabov (arXiv:2506.06441, v1 6 Jun 2025): W ≫ √N for general variance profiles and entry distributions, real symmetric and complex Hermitian, Wigner-Dyson statistics and QUE for diagonal observables in the bulk. Drogin (arXiv:2508.05802, v1 7 Aug 2025): W² ≪ N, eigenvectors exponentially localised at the sharp scale W².

title: The self-avoiding walk in dimensions 2 to 4 is at least diffusive
check: Statement right; the status overstates d = 4. (1) Madras 2014 (Canad. Math. Bull. 57, 113-118) proves E|ω(n)|² ≥ c n^{4/(3d)}, so ν ≥ 2/(3d) if ν exists; that fills the '[verify exponent]'. (2) Bauerschmidt-Brydges-Slade 2015 (arXiv:1403.7422, text read 14 Oct) prove the log^{1/4} correction for the susceptibility of the continuous-time weakly self-avoiding walk in d = 4, χ ~ A ε^{-1}(log ε^{-1})^{1/4}; their introduction says the end-to-end law (E|X(T)|^p)^{1/p} ~ c T^{1/2}(log T)^{1/8} is believed, not proved (their (1.16)). A Laplace-transform version, the finite-order correlation length ξ_p ~ ε^{-1/2}(log ε^{-1})^{1/8}, is Bauerschmidt-Slade-Tomberg-Wallace 2017 (from knowledge). Locator (Madras-Slade, Chapter 1) not checked.
